section: Other renewables - biomass, biofuels (National Policy on Biofuels, ethanol blending), small hydro, geothermal, tidal, waste-to-energy
subsections: Biomass pellets and co-firing in thermal plants

accepted.s: The Biomass Programme primarily provides financial support for which of the following purposes?
o: Construction of tidal power plants in coastal areas
Production of hydrogen exclusively from seawater
Import of uranium for nuclear power generation
Manufacture of pellets and briquettes for power generation
accepted.x: The Biomass Programme funds the manufacture of biomass pellets and briquettes intended for power generation.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise purpose of the programme rather than choosing a neighbouring renewable-energy activity.
accepted.sec: Biomass pellets and co-firing in thermal plants

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding biomass co-firing in coal-based power plants:
1. The Ministry of Power policy issued in 2021 mandated 5% biomass co-firing.
2. The mandated level was to rise to 7%.
3. The policy applied only to hydroelectric power plants.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The 2021 Ministry of Power policy mandated 5% biomass co-firing in coal plants, with a planned increase to 7%. It did not apply only to hydroelectric plants.
accepted.tq: Find the false statement by checking the technology and plant type against the policy.
accepted.sec: Biomass pellets and co-firing in thermal plants

accepted.s: Which institutional mechanism is associated with implementation of biomass co-firing in thermal power plants?
accepted.x: National Mission SAMARTH is associated with the biomass co-firing initiative in thermal power plants.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the implementing mission from other energy policies and schemes.
accepted.sec: Biomass pellets and co-firing in thermal plants

accepted.s:
With reference to ethanol blending in petrol, consider the following statements:
1. Mandatory E20 is scheduled from 1 April 2026.
2. BIS standards extend up to E30.
3. E20 is associated with a possible 1–2% fuel-efficiency loss.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Mandatory E20 is scheduled from 1 April 2026, BIS standards extend up to E30, and the E20 roadmap indicates a possible 1–2% fuel-efficiency loss.
accepted.tq: Combine date, standard and numerical-effect statements; the all-inclusive option is correct here.

accepted.s: The 1–2% fuel-efficiency loss associated with E20 is identified in which policy-related roadmap?
accepted.x: The possible 1–2% fuel-efficiency loss with E20 is identified in the NITI Aayog E20 roadmap of 2021.
accepted.tq: Match the numerical effect with the policy document that quantified it.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the food-versus-fuel debate:
1. Maize-ethanol pricing has been associated with diversion of land from pulses and oilseeds.
2. An increase in maize area has been accompanied by a decline in pulse area.
3. The debate includes concern over rising sugar prices.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The debate covers diversion of land from pulses and oilseeds, rising maize area with declining pulse area, and concerns regarding rising sugar prices.
accepted.tq: Group related consequences under the food-versus-fuel comparison and test all three dimensions.

accepted.s: Which policy of Andhra Pradesh supports biofuels as part of its clean-energy approach?
accepted.x: The AP Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024 supports biofuels.
accepted.tq: Use the exact policy title and year to distinguish it from related sectoral policies.

accepted.s: With reference to geothermal energy in Andhra Pradesh, which of the following statements is correct?
o: The Khammam geothermal site was in Andhra Pradesh before 2014.
The Puga geothermal site was located in Andhra Pradesh before 2014.
Panipat was the geothermal site located in Andhra Pradesh before 2014.
Larderello was the geothermal site located in Andhra Pradesh before 2014.
accepted.x: The Khammam geothermal site was associated with Andhra Pradesh before 2014. Puga and Larderello are cited in the context of Indian and world geothermal sites respectively, while Panipat is associated with a 2G plant.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly mentioned geothermal sites and unrelated renewable-energy locations.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Site or plant)
a. Larderello
b. Puga
c. Panipat
 d. Numaligarh

List-II (Description)
i. First commercial 2G plant
 ii. World geothermal first
 iii. India geothermal first
 iv. First 2G bamboo plant

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Larderello is associated with the world geothermal first, Puga with the Indian geothermal first, Panipat with the first commercial 2G plant, and Numaligarh with the first 2G bamboo plant.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure site–achievement pairs and eliminate codes containing a mismatched first.

accepted.s: The first commercial second-generation (2G) ethanol plant is associated with which location?
accepted.x: Panipat is associated with the first commercial 2G plant.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the commercial 2G plant location from the separate bamboo-based 2G plant location.

accepted.s: The first 2G bamboo ethanol plant is associated with which of the following places?
accepted.x: The first 2G bamboo plant is associated with Numaligarh in Golaghat.
accepted.tq: Use the crop-specific clue—bamboo—to identify the correct plant and location.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the draft CAFE III norms:
1. They are proposed to operate from April 2027.
2. They allow vehicle manufacturers to claim credit for ethanol and CBG.
3. They concern only geothermal electricity generation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The draft CAFE III norms are proposed from April 2027 and allow manufacturers to claim credit for ethanol and CBG. They do not concern only geothermal electricity generation.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme sectoral restriction and retain the correct date and eligible fuels.

accepted.s: Which country has targeted 100% biomethane in its gas grid by 2030 using manure rather than crops?
accepted.x: Denmark has targeted 100% biomethane in its gas grid by 2030, with manure rather than crops as the stated source.
accepted.tq: Test the country–target–feedstock combination as a three-part comparison.

accepted.s: The extension of the Puga geothermal memorandum of understanding was reported in which month and year?
accepted.x: The Puga MoU extension was reported on 26 May 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the month-year combination to separate closely dated current-affairs facts.

accepted.s:
With reference to compressed biogas (CBG), consider the following statements:
1. Progress under SATAT and related targets has been described as limited.
2. About 90% of LPG imports pass through Hormuz.
3. These observations have no connection with energy-security concerns.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: CBG progress has been described as limited despite SATAT and targets, while about 90% of LPG imports pass through Hormuz. These facts are directly relevant to energy security, making statement 3 false.
accepted.tq: Identify the reversed implication in the negative statement while retaining the two stated facts.

accepted.s: Which scheme was reported in connection with small hydro power developments in 2026?
accepted.x: The Small Hydro Power Development Scheme was reported in connection with small hydro developments in 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the renewable-energy source with its specifically named development scheme.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): Geothermal energy can provide 24×7 baseload power.
Reason (R): Geothermal energy is derived from heat available beneath the Earth's surface and is not dependent on daily solar radiation or wind movement.

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the availability of underground geothermal heat explains why geothermal power can provide continuous baseload generation.
accepted.tq: Check whether the reason directly explains the continuity claimed in the assertion.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best expresses the significance of bioenergy mentioned in relation to rural and energy objectives?
o: It replaces all forms of electricity generation with geothermal power.
It is concerned exclusively with reducing sugar prices.
It links tidal ranges, urban transport and nuclear safety.
It links waste management, rural income and energy security.
accepted.x: Bioenergy has the combined significance of linking waste management, rural income generation and energy security.
accepted.tq: Select the option that captures the complete multi-dimensional significance rather than an exclusive claim.

accepted.s:
Match the following installed capacities in Andhra Pradesh with the corresponding energy source:

List-I (Energy source)
a. Bagasse cogeneration
b. Biomass
c. Small hydro
 d. Solar photovoltaic

List-II (Capacity)
i. 106.80 MW
 ii. 171.25 MW
 iii. 206.95 MW
 iv. Not specified in the stated figures

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh had 206.95 MW of bagasse cogeneration, 171.25 MW of biomass and 106.80 MW of small hydro in the stated figures; no solar photovoltaic capacity was specified there.
accepted.tq: Begin with the distinctive capacity figures and eliminate codes that assign them to the wrong energy source.
